description: Check your current in-game currency balance.
Pay another player from your in-game balance.
Buy claim blocks for $1 of in-game currency per block.
Get the golden shovel used to create and edit claims.
Let a player build and break in the claim you're standing in.
notes: Weaker levels: /accesstrust (beds, buttons, levers) and /containertrust (also containers, crops, animals).

description: Remove a player's access to the claim you're standing in.
List who has access to the claim you're standing in.
List your claims and remaining claim blocks.
Delete the claim you're standing in.
Move to nearby unclaimed land when stuck inside someone else's claim.
Browse the available jobs. You can hold up to three jobs at once.
Find nearby chest shops where you can buy an item.
Return to the server spawn.
Teleport to your bed or custom home.
Set your custom home at your current location.
Ask to teleport to another player.
Ask another player to teleport to you.
Accept a pending teleport request.
Teleport to a random location in your current dimension.
notes: The destination is 500–4,000 blocks from the dimension's configured center.

description: Teleport to a random spot in the resource Overworld, the place for heavy mining, chopping, and digging.
notes: Resource worlds reset every Sunday at 10:30 UTC, so don't leave anything behind. Jobs pay 25% more and level 25% faster there. No claims or homes; get back with /spawn, /home, or /back.

description: Teleport to a random spot in the resource Nether.
notes: Once you're there, /tpr hops you around the resource world.

description: Teleport to the main island of the resource End.
notes: The dragon only comes back if someone respawns it with end crystals.

description: Open the AuraSkills menu to view skills and progression.
Open the list of custom enchants available on Cairn SMP.
Type it anywhere in a chat message to show the item in your hand. Other players can hover over it to see its name, enchantments and stats.
Type it in a chat message to show your inventory. Other players can click it to view it.
Type it in a chat message to show your ender chest. Other players can click it to view it.
Type it in a chat message to show your balance.
Type it in a chat message to show your coordinates.
Mention a player in chat to get their attention. They hear a sound and see a note above their hotbar.
Send a private message to a player.
notes: Tip: click a player's name in chat to start a message to them.
